units.source_text: 明治四十一年，秀哉继承师名本因坊以来，每次发生什么事，广月绝轩都是一直支持名人的，而且担任了名人著书的助手。

en.t: Since 1908, when Shusai succeeded to his teacher's title as Honinbo, Kozuki Zekken had always supported the Master whenever anything happened, and he also served as an assistant on the Master's writings.

units.source_text: 他写道：随从名人三十余年，从未听名人说过一句“拜托你了”或是“你辛苦了”之类的话，

en.t: He wrote that in more than thirty years of attending the Master, he had never once heard him say anything like, Please take care of this, or, Thank you for your trouble,

units.source_text: 据说名人因此被人误解为冷酷无情。

en.t: and it is said that because of this the Master was misunderstood as cold and heartless.

units.source_text: 绝轩还写道：社会上纷纷议论，绝轩是在名人授意之下活动。

en.t: Zekken also wrote that people in society were all saying that he was acting under the Master's instructions.

units.source_text: 这种时候，名人也漠然置之。

en.t: Even at such times, the Master remained indifferent and let the matter pass.

units.source_text: 甚至误传过名人在金钱问题上不干不净，

en.t: There was even a false rumor that the Master had been improper in money matters,

units.source_text: 这点绝轩可以马上提出反证。

en.t: but on this point Zekken could immediately offer evidence to the contrary.
